mapper.select: SELECT S.SUPPLIER_ID, S.SUPPLIER_NAME, S.PRODUCT_NAME, S.CATEGORY_CODE , S.BUYING_PRICE, S.CONTACT_NUMBER, S.EMAIL, S.RETURN_TYPE, S.ON_THE_WAY, S.IMAGE_DATA FROM SUPPLIER S WHERE S.SUPPLIER_ID = CAST(#{SUPPLIER_ID} AS BIGINT) AND S.IS_DELETED = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPLIER (SUPPLIER_NAME, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, BUYING_PRICE, CONTACT_NUMBER, EMAIL, RETURN_TYPE, ON_THE_WAY, IMAGE_DATA) VALUES (#{SUPPLIER_NAME}, #{PRODUCT_NAME}, #{CATEGORY_CODE}, CAST(#{BUYING_PRICE} AS NUMERIC), #{CONTACT_NUMBER}, NULLIF(CAST(#{EMAIL} AS VARCHAR), ''), #{RETURN_TYPE}, 0, NULLIF(CAST(#{IMAGE_DATA} AS TEXT), ''))
